ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given points $A$, $B$, $C$, and $D$ lie on the same straight line, with point $C$ being the midpoint of segment $AB$, and point $D$ lies on segment $AB$. If point $E$ is a point on segment $AB$, and $AE=2BE$, when $AD:BD=2:3$, what is the value of $CD:CE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let $AD=2x$, $BD=3x$, then $AB=5x$.\\
Since point C is the midpoint of line segment AB,\\
it follows that $AC=\frac{1}{2}AB=\frac{5}{2}x$,\\
thus $CD=AC-AD=\frac{1}{2}x$,\\
since $AE=2BE$,\\
it follows that $AE=\frac{2}{3}AB=\frac{10}{3}x$,\\
thus $CE=AE-AC=\frac{10}{3}x-\frac{5}{2}x=\frac{5}{6}x$,\\
thus $CD\colon CE=\frac{1}{2}x\colon \frac{5}{6}x=\boxed{3\colon 5}$.
